title: Arcane Ultimatum
summary: Arcane Ultimatum is an Arcane Enhancement that, upon performing a Finisher kill, increases the Warframe's Armor for 45 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Ultimatum is an Arcane Enhancement that, upon performing a Finisher kill, increases the Warframe's Armor for 45 seconds.
Can be sold for  1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for capturing the Eidolon Gantulyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Neptune Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

History
Arcane Ultimatum was first introduced in the Trial mission The Jordas Verdict, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Ultimatum from Little Duck for 2,000  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Ultimatum from Father for 400  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Ultimatum from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 6  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Ultimatum from Ordis for 5  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 6 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Ultimatum from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 4  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).

Notes
The additional armor is unaffected by mods. For example, a  Chroma with a max rank  Steel Fiber, and an active rank-5  Arcane Ultimatum will have an armor rating of:
Armor = Base Armor × (1 + Armor Mod) + Arcane Ultimatum
Armor = 350 × (1 + 1.1) + 1200
Armor = 1935
Parazon Mercy kills will activate the effect.
Duration can be refreshed.
Will not work for  Mercy's Kiss on regular units, i.e. enemies who don't have parazon finishers.

Tips
The following Warframe abilities can trigger finishers
 Ash's  Blade Storm
 Oraxia's  Mercy's Kiss* See Notes
The following Warframe abilities can open enemies up to finishers
 Banshee's  Savage Silence
 Baruuk's  Lull
 Equinox's  Rest & Rage in Night Form
 Excalibur's  Radial Blind
 Gara's Passive
 Inaros'  Desiccation and  Sandstorm
 Ivara's  Quiver
 Lavos'  Ophidian Bite
 Valkyr's  Paralysis
The following Companions can trigger finishers:
 Medjay Predasite's  Infectious Bite and  Paralytic Spores
 Sunika Kubrow's  Savagery
 Sahasa Kubrow's  Ferocity
